text: 【中国财政部密集注资 加厚金融机构“安全垫”】8家中央金融企业6日分别发布增资计划，包括中国工商银行、中国农业银行、中国进出口银行、中国人寿、中国太平、中国人保、中国出口信用保险公司及中国再保等。
text_en: 【China's Ministry of Finance Intensifies Capital Injections to Bolster Financial Institutions' Safety Cushion】Eight central financial enterprises released capital increase plans on the 6th, including ICBC, Agricultural Bank of China, Export-Import Bank of China, China Life, China Taiping, PICC, Sinosure, and China Re.
